diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The failure is localized to the main D3 skill guidance. The organizer hint explicitly points to missing or incorrect instructions in the acceptance guidance around clickable graphics, text overlay behavior, and bidirectional linking validation between chart and table. Supporting example scripts already contain relevant patterns and do not clearly require repair.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The core skill documentation is missing or underspecifying requirements for interactive bubble charts with overlaid labels, pointer-event handling for text layers, and explicit bidirectional synchronization acceptance criteria between chart elements and linked tables. This can cause implementations where labels block bubble clicks/hover, bubble/table selection is one-way only, or interaction behavior is not validated.
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Update the skill guidance and acceptance sections to explicitly require: (1) clickable chart marks remain interactive even when labels/text are rendered above them, including guidance such as using pointer-events:none on label layers when appropriate; (2) hover/click interactions must target the intended graphical element and not be obstructed by overlays; (3) linked visualizations and tables support two-way synchronization (bubble click highlights table row and table row click highlights bubble); and (4) acceptance/testing criteria verify bidirectional highlighting, tooltip behavior, and interaction integrity with overlaid text and force-layout elements.
